season.evidence: Stored Jun-Sep. Web: Mountaineers Wine Spires page lists June-October; Mountain Project says late June to September; Wenatchee Outdoors says latish June to latish September. Histogram: Jul 7, Sep 3.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Logged East Face 5.6R, Jul 13 2014, summited (19 m from our summit pin), in season, and it is the only route on the peak, so identity is fine. But it starts at the bench camp near 7,800 ft (48.5545,-120.5922), not at the trailhead, climbs and then walks out ending 274 m from our trailhead pin; the approach from the road to camp is not recorded, so it is not a complete round trip or trailhead-to-summit track. Offered for the owner to decide.

notes: The single harvested track (aid 432828) is camp to summit to road, missing the first ~3,500 ft of approach; it was left unassigned by the rules. Trip has no report text, so no facts.
